name: theme-examples-default
description: Local copy of Anthropic theme-examples (Apache-2.0) that applies Moonlit Whale (Pixel) to every project with no theme of its own. An example plugin to read, copy and change: thirty-eight animated backdrops behind the chat in the desktop app, with frosted-glass panels: one per project or per session. /custom-theme list names them. Fireworks go off over the theme when Claude says "merged"; /fireworks sets them off by hand.
